reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getBulkActionCategories and reads spending from the sheet's sum-amount cells via getSheetValue, as getCategoryAverage does; the income/tracking check and sign flip have no helper in this tree and are written inline like the siblings.

duplication.why: Only the per-action income/tracking guard and the expense sign flip repeat what every sibling action already spells out inline.

placement.why: Action in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions, registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; a future change to the income rule still has to be repeated per action, as in the existing code.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getBulkActionCategories and spending through the budget sheet.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income guard is a plain copy of the sibling pattern, not reshaped.
